sources.entry: Icons.app - App for macOS which is designed to generate consistent sized icons of an existing application in various states, jiggling (shaking) etc.

summary.one_liner: Icons is a macOS app from SAP that turns a dropped image into a standardized set of app icons (install, uninstall, and animated uninstall PNGs), with optional version banners for IT management workflows.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes an image dragged into its window and generates a full icon set in PNG format, including an installer icon, an uninstaller icon, and an animated version of the uninstaller icon. It can add customizable banners to the icons so admins can track app versions across development, test, and production environments. A custom delete badge can be applied to the uninstall icon. The README also mentions a Finder extension, Image Playground integration for creating icons from scratch, and a command-line interface for automation. It states it runs on macOS 13 and newer.
use_cases: Create standardized app icons from an existing image
Generate install and uninstall icons for Jamf Pro or Munki packages
Add version banners to icons across dev, test, and production
Automate icon set creation from the command line
Design app icons without graphic skills
notable: Generates install, uninstall, and animated uninstall icon sets from one drag-and-drop image
Customizable banners for tagging icons with app version or environment
Finder extension and command-line interface for automation
Image Playground integration to create icons from scratch
Designed to fit management tools such as Jamf Pro and Munki
caveats: Project is provided 'as-is' with no support and no changes planned
Setup and install steps are not given in the README; it points to the wiki for installation
